# Tom Saliba

> Tom Saliba is a retail merchandising consultant based in Greater Manchester, UK, and flexible to travel. He helps omni-channel retailers turn trading performance around: P&L turnarounds, merchandising capability builds, and interim director-level leadership. He has 18 years' experience across Britain's biggest retail names, including ASOS, River Island, Topshop, Missguided, Bonmarché, and Boohoo (Debenhams Group), and was named one of Drapers' "30 Under 30", Class of 2015.

## Services

- **Trading & P&L Recovery**: Diagnose why the numbers are heading the wrong way, then fix it: product critical path, stock age and inventory health, pricing architecture, and promotional mechanics.
- **Merchandising Capability Build**: Build the machine that keeps trading honest: WSSI and range planning, daily and weekly reporting suites, product and marketing forecasting with BI, and the meeting cadence and coaching that make a merchandising team perform.
- **Interim & Advisory Leadership**: Director-level cover and counsel for businesses in transition or between leaders: owning sales, profit, and inventory strategy, hosting executive trade, and partnering with Finance on budgets. Engagements flex from interim cover to a bridge into a permanent seat.
- **Lecturing & Mentoring**: Guest lectures, panels, and coaching on merchandising, omni-channel trading, and building a career in retail. Guest lecturer on undergraduate and masters fashion programmes at Manchester Metropolitan University.

## Track record

- Improved year-on-year revenue performance by 41 percentage points in year one as Merchandising Director at Boohoo, Debenhams Group (2025-26), turning a steep decline into near-level trading, while building DSGN Studio into an independent brand forecast to reach ~£30m revenue.
- Delivered +18% revenue and +21% margin growth in a single year as Merchandise Director at Bonmarché, across 225 stores, ecommerce, and three fulfilment centres (FY24/25).
- Led merchandising for around 45% of Missguided's product revenue as Head of Merchandising (2017-2022).
- Ran Brands & Ivy Park as a Senior Merchandiser at Topshop; learned the trade at ASOS and River Island (2008-2017).
- Coached multiple Heads of Merchandising into senior leadership roles; has led teams of 24.
- Named one of Drapers' "30 Under 30" Next Generation, Class of 2015.

## Career history

- Boohoo, Debenhams Group: Merchandising Director, 2025-present
- Bonmarché: Merchandise Director, 2022-2025
- Missguided: Head of Merchandising, 2017-2022
- Topshop, River Island, ASOS: Merchandiser to Senior Merchandiser, 2008-2017

## Background

- Education: International Business, Finance & Economics, University of Manchester.
- Personal: fifteen international rugby caps for Lebanon; golfer; based in Greater Manchester and flexible to travel.
